DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30) = REPLACE('{0}',',','-') --IF SCANED THE OPERATION CODE (WITH ,), CHANGE TO -, TO MATCH THE QA DOCNUM DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30) = '' DECLARE @ROUALT VARCHAR(30) = '' DECLARE @ROUOPE VARCHAR(30) = '' DECLARE @ITMNO VARCHAR(30) = ''
SET @MFGNUM=LEFT(@DOCNUM, CHARINDEX('-', @DOCNUM) - 1); SET @ROUOPE=RIGHT(@DOCNUM, LEN(@DOCNUM) - CHARINDEX('-', @DOCNUM));
--SELECT @ROUALT = H.ROUALT_0 -- ,@ITMNO = H.ROUNUM_0 --FROM #LC.X3DATA#MFGHEAD H --WHERE H.MFGNUM_0 = @MFGNUM;
-- DEMO DATA, RANDY, 2026-10-17 SELECT @ROUALT = 11, @ITMNO = 'WR4080ED002.286'
-- 拼接形成 ROUCOD DECLARE @ROUCOD VARCHAR(30)
SET @ROUCOD = CONCAT_WS('-', @ITMNO, @ROUALT, @ROUOPE)
SELECT QL.OPENUM CODE ,IIF(L.STA=2,'【√】','')+D.OPEDES2 DESP ,QL.INSTCAT ,IIF(L.INSTCOD IS NULL, ISNULL(QL.INSTCOD, ''), L.INSTCOD) INSTCOD FROM QAROU H INNER JOIN QAROULIN QL ON QL.ROUCOD = H.ROUCOD INNER JOIN QAOPESTD D ON QL.OPESTD = D.OPESTD LEFT JOIN QAINSPL L ON L.DOCNUM = @DOCNUM AND L.OPENUM = QL.OPENUM WHERE H.ROUCOD = @ROUCOD
